title: Lights from the Gate
text: Your watchtower's keeper reports that every night a line of lanterns comes from the Rift Gate across the fields toward the city. They never arrive, but each night they are a little nearer.

options.label: Ride out to meet the lanterns and learn who carries them.

outcomes.text: Nobody carries the lanterns. The Scion who rode out brings one back, and it shows the way through dark places.
The lanterns close around the rider, who comes back at dawn with white hair and nothing to say.

options.label: Warn the city so every door is barred before they arrive.

outcomes.text: The city bars its doors at dusk. The lanterns stop at the edge of the fields, as if disappointed.

options.label: Keep watching and say nothing; knowledge is worth more than panic.

outcomes.text: Each night the keeper writes down the count. The numbers are rising.
